decisions.replacement: As its official name suggested, the majestic people of this vast continent still embraced socialism as their national ideology.

decisions.replacement: Team Leader Choi, who had been responding to Wei Penghu, silently moved his lips. His poker face was astonishing.

decisions.replacement: *He was going to answer in the end anyway. Why make such a fuss?*

decisions.replacement: It was still vivid: the city plunged into pandemonium beneath the hologram’s light, and a man at the head of the Hunters cutting down monsters one after another.

decisions.replacement: Team Leader Choi and I locked eyes in midair. At that moment, we were thinking the same thing.

decisions.reason: Heard rumors is more natural, but 사실이었나 is singular it, not they.
decisions.replacement: *I’d only heard rumors about things like this. So it was true?*

decisions.reason: Looked down on is the contemporary US rendering; upon is only a formality swap.

decisions.replacement: *Seriously. Even after going through the Great Cataclysm, they’re still jockeying for advantage like this.*

decisions.replacement: I felt as though I’d caught a glimpse of the truth of a world I’d never understood, and it left me with a strange feeling.

decisions.replacement: Over his desperately pleading shoulder, I saw Team Leader Choi shaking his head.
